mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Classic and Studio, each at scale 1/light and scale 2/dark with repeated layout. Escape discards typed opacity without changing document semantics, history ticket or pending canvas text. A later separate Escape cancels canvas text. Enter publishes exactly once and Undo restores document semantics. Pointer dragging leaves committed opacity unchanged until release, which publishes once.

regression_baseline.scope: The unchanged cancellation prefix of the regression; baseline stops before the later acceptance and drag checks.
regression_baseline.result: Before the fix, Escape committed the typed opacity 72 instead of preserving 255. The expected baseline failure is archived separately from current passing logs.

scope: Typed opacity is staged until acceptance; focused Escape captures cancellation across the entire frame so repeated layout cannot publish the numeric widget private edit buffer. Existing pointer-release publication remains.
limits: Normal focused-field Escape is tested, not arbitrary native event coalescing or IME. Accepting a property edit retains pending-text resolution policy; the test separately cancels canvas text before verifying one ordinary property publication. Native appearance and complete reference fidelity remain unqualified.
